summary: Guitchordi is a six-string chord instrument: pick a chord on the black keys, then strum or pluck strings on the white keys. Beta, tested on one FM-1.
features: White keys are strings in zones; black keys pick chords
16 instruments: guitars, harp, violin, cello, bass, dulcimer
50 chord styles from jazz and blues to pop and rock
Strum mode with direction, division and speed; chord lock
Fourteen guitar tunings, including Drop D and open tunings
Settings not saved to flash on the device

headings: play in the fm-1 panel simulator
open http://localhost:8769 and click switch on
